headline: Ratified Joint Building Committee actions and approved up to $3,780 from Zylonis Trust for Sarasota Musica Viva concert
summary: The board unanimously ratified actions taken during the Joint Committee on Infrastructure and Library Board of Trustees meeting held before this one. The board also unanimously approved a request not to exceed $3,780 from the Zylonis Trust to Sarasota Musica Viva for a lecture and concert at the library.

plain_text:
Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees  
August 4, 2026  
6:30 PM  
MINUTES 
A meeting of the Nashua Public Library Board of Trustees was held Tuesday, August 4, 2026, scheduled 
at 6:30 PM at the Nashua Public Library, 2 Court Street, Nashua, NH, 03060  
1. Call to Order 
 
 Meeting was called to order at 8:00 PM 
2. Attendance 
 
 In attendance:  
Linda LaFlamme, Chair  
Scott Jaquith, Secretary 
John Kennedy 
Ernest Jette 
Patricia Dresner 
Jennifer McCormack, Director 
3. Approval of recommendations from Joint Special Building committee 
 
 Upon a motion by Mr. Jaquith, seconded by Mr. Kennedy the board unanimously ratified the actions 
taken during the Joint Committee on Infrastructure and Library Board of Trustees meeting 
immediately preceding this meeting.  
4. Zylonis trust request 
Pending a final proposal from the group requesting the funds. 
 
 Upon a motion by Ms. Dresner, seconded by Mr. Jette the Board unanimously approved a request 
for an amount not to exceed $3,780 from the Zylonis Trust to Sarasota Musica Viva for a lecture 
and concert to be held at the library.  
5. Adjourn 
 
 Upon a motion by Mr Kennedy, seconded by Mr. Jaquith the meeting was adjourned at 8:27 PM.
